title: Inbox timeline: one record per thing, two streamed indexes; three edits outside my fence are waiting

owner_note.text: The inbox is built from what each writer already appends (card page.jsonl, each task's landing line), read through two indexes (cards.jsonl, timeline/landings.jsonl) streamed with live(); board.jsonl is retired read-only. Alternatives were a node Query source (dev-only) or one new inbox.jsonl (a third copy that drifts). Not done yet, exact text in the doc: Server/on-landing.mjs should run Landings.mjs --append on every landing, the AI page's Inbox tab should read Timeline instead of polling cards.jsonl every 20 s, and health-watch should post owner notes instead of writing board.jsonl.
